title.en: How Will the Last Page of the Paper Parade End?
title.zh: 纸游行最后一页，会怎样写完？

description.en: Choose an actual branching ending for an original tale about a paper parade arriving at an unfinished square.
description.zh: 为原创纸游行抵达未完广场的故事，沿真正分支选一个结尾。

introduction.en: A fictional parade of paper figures reaches a square with a blank final page. No choice is a moral test. Your route determines what happens in the tale: a returned object, a new shared scene or an open continuation.
introduction.zh: 纸角色的虚构游行到广场，最后一页仍空。选择不作道德考题。路线决定归还小物、新共作景或开放延续。

focus.en: Deciding what an original tale resolves, what its characters make together and what it leaves available beyond the final page.
focus.zh: 给原创故事写个结尾：归还一件小物、留下大家一起完成的场景，或给下一段旅程留一条路。

prompt.en: The paper parade reaches a square. You follow…

label.en: A figure carrying a sign that belongs somewhere else.
label.zh: 拿着应放别处牌子的纸人。

label.en: A group arranging an empty circle in the square.
label.zh: 在广场排空圆圈的一组纸人。

prompt.en: The sign came from the parade’s starting bench. You choose…
prompt.zh: 牌子来自出发长椅，你选……

label.en: Return with the figure to see the bench again.
Ask whether the sign can have a place in the new circle.
label.zh: 问牌子可否在新圆圈有位置。

prompt.en: The circle has a space no figure has claimed. You choose…
prompt.zh: 圆圈有一处无人认领空位，你选……

label.en: Invite one optional contribution from each willing figure.
label.zh: 邀每位愿意纸人添一小份。

label.en: Keep the gap as a path beyond the square.
label.zh: 留空口，作广场外的小路。

prompt.en: At the starting bench, the figure can…

label.en: Put the sign back and end with a view of the quiet bench.
label.zh: 放回牌，以安静长椅景收尾。

label.en: Leave a note and take a new blank sign toward the square.
label.zh: 留便条，带新空牌往广场。

prompt.en: The willing figures have made a small shared scene. You…
prompt.zh: 愿意的纸人共造小景，你会……

label.en: End with the scene and its different contributions visible.
label.zh: 让小景与各份贡献可见，收尾。

label.en: Let one figure leave a blank space for tomorrow’s addition.
label.zh: 让一纸人留空，给明天添加。

prompt.en: The final page has one spare corner. You put…

label.en: A path that continues beyond the page, with no required destination.
label.zh: 一条延伸纸外的路，不指定终点。

label.en: The starting bench beside the square, linking the two scenes.
label.zh: 把出发长椅放广场旁，连起两景。

title.en: The Ending That Returns One Small Thing

summary.en: Your route closes a modest loop in the original tale. The bench and sign connect the last scene with the first, without claiming that every character’s future is now settled.
summary.zh: 你的路线让故事前后呼应。结尾的长椅和招牌连回开头，完成了一个小小的心愿，但不表示所有角色的未来都已经安排好了。

example.en: The final illustration might show the sign resting beside the bench while the paper square remains visible in the distance.
example.zh: 最后一幅插图，可以画招牌靠在长椅旁，远处仍看得见纸片广场。

strength.en: A concrete return gives the reader a recognizable point of closure and lets a small object carry the connection between scenes.
strength.zh: 一件具体的小物回到原处，就能让读者认出故事已经收尾，也把前后的场景连起来。

tradeoff.en: A neat loop can feel too complete if every loose detail is forced back into place. This ending only resolves the one object it follows.
tradeoff.zh: 如果每个零散细节都必须回到原位，结局也可能收得太满。这个结尾只解决它一路跟随的那件小物，其他事情可以留着。

experiment.en: Write two opening lines for a fictional object’s journey and a last line that returns to it. Leave at least one surrounding detail unresolved.
experiment.zh: 为一件虚构小物的旅程写两句开头，再写一句与它呼应的结尾。周围至少留一件事，不必交代到底。

title.en: The Ending Made from Several Contributions

summary.en: Your route ends with a scene the willing figures made together. The final page shows different contributions sharing a place without insisting that every character wanted the same ending.
summary.zh: 你的故事结束在一幅大家自愿一起完成的场景里。不同的贡献放在同一个地方，但不要求每个角色都想要同样的结局。

example.en: One figure’s sign, another’s paper arch and a third’s little drawing might form a square that none of them designed alone.
example.zh: 一个角色带来招牌，一个折了纸拱门，还有一个画了一张小画。它们合成了没有任何一人能独自设计出的广场。

strength.en: Visible contributions make the shared ending concrete and give the reader several small actions to recognize rather than a vague claim of togetherness.
strength.zh: 具体画出谁添了什么，读者就能看懂这幅场景怎样一起完成，而不只听到一句笼统的“大家很团结”。

tradeoff.en: A shared scene can still leave out quieter perspectives. The story can acknowledge a figure who watched or declined without treating them as a problem.
tradeoff.zh: 一起完成的场景，也可能没说出安静角色的感受。故事可以留意只在旁边看、或选择不参加的人，不把他们当成问题。

experiment.en: Invent a three-character final scene and give each willing contributor one distinct harmless addition. Let a fourth character simply enjoy the view.
experiment.zh: 为三个自愿参与的角色各安排一件不同的小东西，一起组成最后的场景。再留一个第四位角色，让他只欣赏也可以。

title.en: The Ending with a Path Beyond the Page
title.zh: 纸页之外仍有路的结尾

summary.en: Your route lets the tale stop while one possibility remains open. The continuing path is an invitation to imagine, not a promise of a sequel or a refusal to finish the present scene.
summary.zh: 你的故事在这里告一段落，仍有一条路可以继续想象。它不承诺一定有续篇，也不需要因为留了可能，就拒绝为眼前这一幕收尾。

example.en: The final corner might show a narrow paper path leaving the square while the completed parade rests behind it.
example.zh: 最后一幅画的角落，可以有一条窄窄的纸路离开广场，已经抵达的游行队伍则在后面休息。

strength.en: An open continuation lets the world feel larger than the selected story while still giving the reader a clear last image to keep.
strength.zh: 留一点延续的可能，读者就能感到世界还比这一个故事更大，同时仍有一幅明确的最后画面可以记住。

tradeoff.en: Openness can feel evasive if the current scene never reaches a stopping point. This parade has arrived; only the next journey remains undecided.
tradeoff.zh: 如果眼前这一幕始终没有结束，留白也可能像在回避收尾。这次游行已经到达广场，没决定的只是下一段旅程。

experiment.en: Write a fictional final image with one completed action and one open path. Make the completed part clear before adding any hint of continuation.
experiment.zh: 写一幅虚构故事的结尾画面：一件行动已经完成，一条路仍然敞开。先交代完成的部分，再给继续想象的提示。

description.en: Finish an original paper-parade tale through actual branches. Return one small thing, reveal a shared scene or leave a path beyond the page, with full guides to every ending.
description.zh: 沿真正分支写完原创纸游行：归还小物、显出共作景，或留纸页外的路。所有结局都有完整指南。

question.en: Can an open ending still finish the paper parade's story?
question.zh: 开放结局，也能完成纸游行故事吗？

answer.en: The parade has reached the square, so the current action can finish while a possible next path remains open. Returning an object and showing a shared scene close different parts of the tale; none requires resolving every character's future.
answer.zh: 游行已到广场，因此当下动作可完成，同时留下一条可能新路。归还物件和展示共作景收不同部分，都不需解决每个角色的未来。
